title: Smoky Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Chinese-style stew made with lentils and a blend of aromatic spices. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add the lentils, stew, and 2 cups of water to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
